label: Sector Forward P/E (12-month forward consensus, weekly)

source.method: Terminal data — 12-month blended-forward consensus P/E, per index
source.frequency: one point per week (last reading of each ISO week)
source.forwardOwnMethod: Blended forward 12M: FY1/FY2 consensus net income weighted by published ETF holdings; one point per day. Agrees with the terminal blended-forward series to within 3% on all four universes (verified 2026-08-05). Published as a separate array and never merged into `series` — different estimate vintage, different weighting, different cadence.

note: Forward PE = price / 12-month consensus EPS estimate. `series` is terminal data on a blended-forward basis, published as one point per week; `forwardOwn` is a separately computed daily line, given for the sectors where one is available. The two are never blended. Sectors with no export on file are omitted, and come online as readings are added. Where the sector carries an EPS-near-zero / negative-EPS stretch in history (SOX 2002-2010 is the canonical example), `stats` is computed from a clean post-distortion window so the percentile / mean / peak descriptors stay informative; the chart shows the full series with the distortions clipped against the visible ceiling.
